briefdescription.para: Integration regression coverage for analytics serving and export failure classes.

detaileddescription.para:
Covers three previously-open Q4 2026 roadmap items:
"strengthen bounded-memory behavior in high-cardinality streaming windows" → max_distinct_partition_keys enforcement for TumblingWindow, SlidingWindow, HoppingWindow (SEI-01..SEI-03).
"extend integration regression coverage for serving and export failure classes" → ModelServingEngine fail-closed on integrity mismatch (SEI-04..SEI-05), TFServingBackend insecure-transport block (SEI-06), ExportResult error path on invalid output (SEI-07).
"improve distributed merge diagnostics and operator-facing telemetry" → operator_hints populated on shard failures (SEI-08..SEI-10), total_execution_ms and merge_duration_ms populated (SEI-11..SEI-12).
